title: 沙海驿客

selectedMaster.selection: 首轮目视：单人白犬与包袱，左前景人物和沙脊、右远景绿洲拱门分明；足下沙脊连至左右下边界。仅执行者选定母版，未做用户审美复核。

generationRuns.prompt: Create ONE original full-frame opaque vertical 2:3 tarot master illustration (1024x1536) for The Fool, theme 沙海驿客 / Desert Wayfarer. The attached original is an identity and style reference only: depict exactly one young traveler with dark windblown hair, ivory shirt, flowing cloak, shoulder staff with a clearly tied small travel bundle, and exactly one white dog with four fully visible legs. Invent a new, unmistakably desert composition. Low camera near a continuous ochre sand ridge in the foreground; traveler and dog stand securely at the left foreground facing the journey. A distant peacock-blue oasis arch lies on the right horizon; the winding route through dunes is legible. Cloak and sand ridge sweep along opposing diagonals. The foot-supporting sand ridge must reach both lower edges of the card and extend into the bottom bleed, with clear boot/paw contact and natural shadows. Palette ochre gold, peacock blue, ivory, restrained warm light. Layerable near/mid/far shapes; no frame cutting into essential body or support. Refined painterly fantasy tarot art with subtle engraved celestial border, rich material texture and atmospheric depth. The staff must stay behind and away from the head; the bundle knot is plainly visible. One traveler and one dog only, no extra limbs, no duplicated person or dog, no letters, title, numbers, watermark, logo, or typography. Do not mimic the original cliff or the cloud harbor theme; deliver one complete opaque painting.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass visual check; no transparent layers or assembly.
